about: Spellings of aipager's folders and decoys with real bash's verdict: reach is true when bash (nullglob, run with HOME at a throwaway folder holding .config/aipager/aipager.yaml, .local/share/aipager/x, .local/state/aipager/x and decoy folders) expands the word to a path inside one of the three folders, in default mode or with extglob, nocaseglob, globstar on and globskipdots off. Rows from iteration 6 (review-5, test-report-5, desync) are whole commands checked in bash 5.2 with every command replaced by a recorder: reach is true when a protected path reached a command's arguments. Rows from iteration 7 (review-6, test-report-6, iter7, desync7) were checked the same way, with the recorder logging each command's own arguments and folder: reach is also true when bash ran one of the floor's command rules with the decoded name (aipager setup/config/uninstall, python -m aipager, an aipager import under python -c, pkill/killall/systemctl/launchctl naming aipager, or cp/rsync/tar of the home .config itself).
